---
title: "Olympic Beach Volleyball: Which Countries Are the Most Successful?"
format: html
---

## My Final Project

For my final project, I want to explore which countries have been the most successful in Olympic beach volleyball. I am interested in comparing countries based on their performance over time and seeing whether certain countries consistently perform better than others.

## Variables I Want to Explore

Some interesting variables I would like to analyze include the country representing each team, the year of the Olympics, the gender of the competition, match results, and medal placements. I want to use these variables to compare countries and identify patterns in Olympic beach volleyball success.

## My Research Question

Which countries have been the most successful in Olympic beach volleyball, and how has their success changed over time?

## Data and Medal Comparison

I used the public medalist tables from [List of Olympic medalists in beach volleyball](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Olympic_medalists_in_beach_volleyball), which link to the details for each tournament. From 1996 through 2024, the men's and women's tables each have 8 rows and 4 variables: Games, Gold, Silver, and Bronze. Together, that is 16 rows and 4 variables. The code below reshapes those tables into 48 team-medal records with 4 variables: year, gender, country, and medal. Each medal is counted once for its team, not once for each athlete.

I checked the totals against [Olympedia's beach volleyball overview](https://www.olympedia.org/sports/VBV), which reports 14 medals for Brazil and 11 for the United States through 2024.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)

source_url <- "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Olympic_medalists_in_beach_volleyball"
source_page <- read_html(source_url)
source_tables <- html_elements(source_page, "table.wikitable")
beach_tables <- source_tables[3:4]

read_medals <- \(table, gender) {
  rows <- html_elements(table, "tr")[-1]

  map_dfr(rows, \(row) {
    cells <- html_elements(row, "td")
    year <- as.integer(str_extract(html_text2(cells[[1]]), "\\d{4}"))

    if (is.na(year) || year < 1996 || year > 2024) {
      return(tibble())
    }

    tibble(
      year = year,
      gender = gender,
      country_code = map_chr(cells[2:4], \(cell) {
        str_match(html_text2(cell), "\\(([A-Z]{3})\\)")[, 2]
      }),
      medal = c("Gold", "Silver", "Bronze")
    )
  })
}

beach_medals <- map2_dfr(beach_tables, c("Men", "Women"), read_medals) |>
  mutate(
    country = recode(
      country_code,
      BRA = "Brazil",
      USA = "United States",
      GER = "Germany",
      AUS = "Australia",
      SUI = "Switzerland",
      CAN = "Canada",
      CHN = "China",
      NOR = "Norway",
      ESP = "Spain",
      ITA = "Italy",
      LAT = "Latvia",
      NED = "Netherlands",
      QAT = "Qatar",
      ROC = "Russian Olympic Committee",
      SWE = "Sweden",
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  select(year, gender, country, medal)

if (nrow(beach_medals) != 48 || anyNA(beach_medals$country)) {
  stop("The source tables did not produce all 48 medal records.")
}

country_medals <- beach_medals |>
  count(country, name = "total_medals") |>
  arrange(desc(total_medals))

ggplot(country_medals, aes(x = reorder(country, total_medals), y = total_medals)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#176B87", width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = total_medals), hjust = -0.3, fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "Olympic Beach Volleyball Medals by Country",
    subtitle = "Team medals from 1996 through 2024, men's and women's events",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total medals",
    caption = "Source: List of Olympic medalists in beach volleyball; accessed October 30, 2026."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
